summary: Verified safe-area + responsive fixes and regression on all backend endpoints. 31/31 backend tests pass (19 original + 12 new regression: members expiring/lookup, expenses CRUD, stock purchase auto-expense, cash-closing summary, reports/summary alert keys, reports/range week for admin=7d + staff clamped<=2d). Frontend at 390x844 renders correctly: SafeAreaProvider mounted; login hero respects top notch; bottom tab bar sits at bottom (top=791,bottom=838 within 844) without overlap; new-bill, cash-closing and bill/[id] use inline paddingBottom=Math.max(insets.bottom+6,16) via useSafeAreaInsets; every reference screen wraps header in SafeAreaView edges=['top'] and forms in KeyboardAvoidingView. Admin dashboard shows Today card + low-stock alert + Month card + Top Performers. Staff dashboard shows Today card + 3 quick actions (New Bill, Today's Bills, Daily Report) + Top Performers, NO Month card and NO expiring-members alert. Staff Stock screen hides Inventory Value card, unit-cost text and Purchase(+) button; the '-' (Use) button is still shown. Logo file /app/frontend/assets/images/glow-logo-mark.png present (164690 bytes). No React Native red screens; no deprecated packages detected in the reviewed files (expo-status-bar in use, no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch).

issues: Staff sees the low-stock alert card too (visible: '2 item(s) low on stock'). Spec said staff dashboard should show ONLY Today's Revenue + 3 quick actions + Top Performers. Confirm whether low-stock alert is intended for staff; if not, gate it behind isAdmin.

action_items: Decide whether the low-stock alert card should also be hidden for staff on the Dashboard (currently shown). Spec wording says staff dashboard shows 'only' those three sections.
critical_code_review_comments: Tab bar height = 60 + insets.bottom; paddingBottom = Math.max(insets.bottom, 6). On Android with gesture nav insets.bottom will typically be 24-30px so gesture-area overlap is prevented. Verified visually on web (insets.bottom=0 → 6px pad).
reports/range preset=week correctly clamps staff to <=2 days (backend regression test).
reports/summary correctly emits low_stock[] always and expiring_members[] only for admin (empty for staff).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all reviewed flows pass; single minor spec ambiguity on staff dashboard low-stock card)

seed_data_creation: None persisted; test members/stock/expenses were cleaned up after each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend has two pytest files at /app/backend/tests/ (test_glowup_backend.py 19 tests, test_glowup_regression.py 12 tests). Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Frontend uses testIDs sparingly on login (login-email/login-password not found on web); prefer text selectors 'Sign In' button and inputs[0]/[1] fill for auth. Bottom tab labels: Dashboard, New Bill, Expenses, History, Manage. Staff quick actions: New Bill, Today's Bills, Daily Report.
